messages:
maria: Quick Q — who owns the data-residency gating for the new eu-north-2 region? Need confirmation on KMS + S3 residency before we open routing. ETA for end-to-end by next Tue?
kevin: I had infra on KMS config. cc @priya for S3 bucket policy. I can take the routing PR once KMS is green. :+1: Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/regions
priya: S3 policy note: we need to disable cross-account replication and enforce a region tag on newly created buckets. Posting policy snippet in a sec.
priya: policy snippet:
```json
{
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": { "aws:RequestedRegion": "eu-north-2" }
  }
}
```
alex: For routing, I'll add the region->edge mapping and a fallback rule for capacity tiers. I'll open a PR shortly: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4821 — @jon can you review the routing rules?
jon: I can review later today. quick check: does the KV cache warmup pipeline support eu-north-2 shards or do we need a minor change? @sahil?
sahil: KV warmup looks ok but I'll run a focused load test tomorrow 09:00 UTC (N=1000 RPS, 30m). Will post results and tail logs.
deploy-bot: Canary window reserved for eu-north-2: 2026-03-22 02:00-06:00 UTC (account: infra-canary)
maria: Short deps checklist (from this thread): KMS config (infra), S3 policy (storage), DB read replica + failover (db), routing PR + CR (infra), canary window (deploy), monitoring dashboards (observability). Please confirm owners and ETA.
kevin: I'll take KMS + DB replica, target Wed EOD. @priya can you confirm S3 by Tue EOD?
priya: Yes, Tue EOD. I'll add the policy and create a PR for the bucket lifecycle configs.
alex: Routing PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4821 (contains route table diff + tests). Requesting quick CR from @jon and @maria.
jon: Reviewing now, should be able to merge after infra CI passes.
sahil: Load test scheduled, will upload aggregated p95/p99 and cost delta.
maria: Thanks — once we have KMS + S3 green and routing merged, I'll slot the canary. If anything slips, call it out here and we'll replan the milestone. :calendar:
kevin: noted. I'll post KMS ARN and replica snapshot id when ready.
priya: Adding myself to the routing PR for visibility.
maria: Awesome — keeping this thread as the single source for ownership. If anyone needs to reassign, reply here.
